items.description: Restricted object keys remain only in the protected manifest; JSON Schema consumers also check unique versions.

source_action.description: The source action the operator_effect_outbox row had when it was frozen; replay deletes the row only if it still has it.

entry_id.description: The waiting-list entry the delivery was addressed for (its target); the entry itself may already be gone.

source_action.description: The source action of the delivery's effect when it was frozen; replay deletes the delivery only if its effect still has it.

table.description: The table the range was deleted from.

series_id.description: The one datapoint series of the range; absent when the range covers every series of the robot. Never set for latency buckets.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound of the deleted range (UTC, milliseconds).

cutoff.description: Exclusive upper bound of the deleted range (UTC, milliseconds). Replay deletes every row of the table inside [from, cutoff) for this robot and series and no row at or after the cutoff.

row_count.description: How many rows the range held when it was frozen.

rows_digest.description: SHA-256 over the sorted row keys the range held when it was frozen (retention range digest v1); lets a backup of the range be checked against what was deleted.

items.description: JSON Schema consumers must also check uuid_row generation equality, exact physical identity and that a retention range starts before it ends.
